notes.title: Version 1.6 Update (Maid Service)
notes.notes:
What's new in Version 1.6:
New playable Maid minigame in Maganrock Tavern released!
Added new menu display for equipping maid costume (for work)
Added 69 new scenes for Maid Service
Added sound effects for Slap, BJ, and F scenes.
Added 13 new animations for Maid Service
Added 2 new rewards for attaining following 'ranks' for Maid Service minigame:
- Celebrity 
- Whxxx Status

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44858132/ee17e6fab073a0ec0a1f2198e7d2f3a53195bb4d.png

Maid Service Mini-game:
Player can now sign up to work as a maid at the MaganRock Tavern in Magania Merchant District 
1. Speak to the Maganrock Tavern boss to initiate an employment
2. Maid costume have to be worn to start the game - just speak to the barkeep to begin!
3. Orders will be assigned to player - match the order as assigned by the barkeep to the matching table color to complete the delivery.
4. Wrong deliveries will result in (un)desirable events!! -% to trigger is based on your submissiveness and notoriety values.
5. Remember to speak to the boss after the day's work to collect your work payment.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44858132/dfd4b8dc6866214aea48922be8bb03734349896a.png

Things to note:
*Accepting 'extracurricular' events will raise your notoriety as a maid.
*Participating in said events also slightly increase (or reduce) the stat associated with triggering them.
*There are no lasting penalties for serving the wrong orders… >:)
*Be careful—excessive submissiveness may cause certain events to auto-trigger, leaving you with no chance to refuse any advances!
*It is recommended to remove any mercenary prior to starting the mini-game.
*There are no quest markers for the maid minigame at this time.

Changes & Improvements:
Reworked graphical asset upgrades - Several icons and menu art have been updated to visualise items & equipment better.
Fixed several minor bugs, typos.

notes.title: Version 1.5 Update (Phase 1)
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 Update (Phase 1/3)

We’re rolling out the Version 1.5 (Phase 1) update with significant improvements and additions to the game. 
This is the first part of a multi-phase update aimed at enhancing gameplay, visuals, and overall quality.

 New Features
- Dev Logo Added: The official developer logo has been introduced to the Game Intro.
- Heroine Party Photo: A new party photo has been added to the Game Intro.
- Battle Background Enhancements: Reworked and updated battle backgrounds for improved visual quality.
- New Background Scenes: Additional battle background scenes included for side quest zones.
- Updated Slave Scene Animations: New animations introduced for smoother visuals.
- Limit Break Cut-Ins: Added more cut-ins for the protagonist and main story companions.
- Evendale Great Library Lore: Expanded lore content added to the library.


 Changes & Improvements
- Reduced Quest Grinding:
  - Grinding requirements for main story quest items have been significantly reduced:
    - Straund’s Bridge Quest
    - Sidd’s Repair Quest
- Adjusted Limit Break Scenes: Fine-tuned for better flow during combat.
- QoL Improvements:
  - Spell and skill categories reworked for easier navigation and selection.

Phase 1 focuses on core updates and visual improvements. 
Work for Phase 2 is already underway and will include additional features and refinements. 

As always, feedback is appreciated. 
Thank you for your continued support.

Playable Slave Arc content added
Players can now be enslaved through the slave system in major cities.
Slavers patrolling the region will check on your freedom and SLV rating before considering throwing you in the right place.

Slaver patrol system overhaul
Players will now encounter slaver patrols in major cities.
Encounter rate will be based off player's SLV rating, as well as any offense committed. The higher the SLV rating, the easier it is for the slavers to check up on you. Certain stats may help in evading checks.
Freedom license can be acquired to avoid harassment by slavers as well.

Freedom License added
Freedom license may now be purchased from 'Freedom Ambassadors' in all major cities.
They are located in the King's (or Queens's) audience halls right before you meet them.

Classic RPG Mode: 2.0x EXP
Real Game Mode: 1.5x EXP 

An improvement update for CG & animation scenes is set to drop by Oct 2024.

notes.title: Hotfix #15
notes.notes:
Mercenary Bug (Magania Boat Scene)
- Fixed critical bug where newer mercenaries cannot rejoin after the Magania boat trip battle scene. All mercenaries that were hired before Magania should now be working as intended. 

If you had a save file just before the Magania boat fight scene, please load that save to resolve this issue.

Fret not if you already progressed into Magania, there will be an NPC near the Teleport Crystal (Magania) that will fix your mercenary problem for 2000 Gold.


Class change EXP/LEVEL discrepancies
- The class change promotion may display some level discrepancies and it 
is normal. This is due to the different EXP gauges for its respective class and the game only retains the accumulated EXP and adjusts its level to the new class. So players may see a 'drop' in level but that's working as intended. No changes will be made further to this.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Notes

 Reworked entire Nephalia world map to reduce stutter and performance loss.
 Nephalia world is now split into 3 separate maps.

- Kingdom of Evendale
- Empire of Magania
- Realm of Akendius

 Added removal codes to autorun events for newly added maps.
Existing saves should now work properly.
 Added hotkey 'N' and 'Numpad *'
 Added the option to toggle between High and Low End Spec during your playthrough instead of only the character creation screen. (*A new playthrough is required for this function)
 Added item Map of Nephalia, use N to toggle the world map. 
Requires the item to be in your inventory.


Bug fixes


 Fixed '3 hungry bears' troop with immortal states. 
 Fixed Evendale to Magania Boat Scene where unlicensed mercenaries decide to join your party illegally.
 Fixed Mia or Bigelo trying to muscle into your party even before story companion Lance joins your party.

An existing save game should be compatible to play, but you must take an additional step to enter and exit a house or room before leaving into the world map, to avoid cached events that are loaded from saves.

A new playthrough is recommended.

As there is a large amount of path scripts being reworked, there may be
paths that might be missed. In the event of such occurences, please kindly leave a bug report in the discussion board and the issue will be attended to promptly.

If there are any bugs or major issues, please kindly post in the discussion forum.

notes.title: Forbidden Fantasy the RPG Release date
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

I hope this message finds all of you well. I am excited to share an update with all of you. 
The official release date for Forbidden Fantasy the RPG, is set for March 22, 2024.

As we reach the final stages of development, we're carefully placing the last pieces and working diligently to squash any game-breaking bugs. It's been quite a journey, and it is nearing the finish line.

We're looking forward to welcoming you to the world of Forbidden Fantasy on March 22nd.

Warm regards,
Lyen,
ZXLStudio
